HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 2
Privilege log of Plaintiff Jane Doe for production volume JD-PROD-001, September 10,
2013
Each entry is a claim by counsel. The court decides whether a claim holds.
PL-001. JD000051-JD000051. 2012-10-18. Email from Jane Doe to Lisa Low. Basis
claimed: Attorney-client privilege. Client request for legal advice about the reply
to her demand letter.
PL-002. JD000085-JD000085. 2013-05-07. Notes from Lisa Low to File. Basis claimed:
Work product. Counsel notes of a call about the production schedule.
PL-003. JD000086-JD000086. 2012-10-20. Letter from Lisa Low to Jane Doe. Basis
claimed: Attorney-client privilege. Counsel instruction to keep documents.
PL-004. JD000087-JD000087. 2013-04-23. Memo from Lisa Low to File. Basis claimed:
Work product. Counsel notes prepared for this case.
PL-005. JD000088-JD000088. 2013-08-20. Memo from Lisa Low to Jane Doe. Basis
claimed: Attorney-client privilege and work product. Counsel advice about resolving
the case.

PL-006. JD000089-JD000089. 2013-03-12. Spreadsheet from Lisa Low to File. Basis
claimed: Work product. Counsel chart of claims and proof.
PL-007. JD000090-JD000090. 2013-03-19. Spreadsheet from Ed Expert to Lisa Low. Basis

PL-008. JD000091-JD000092. 2013-04-16. Memo from Ed Expert to Lisa Low. Basis
